title: transit: remove unused serde_ipld_dagcbor dependency
description: serde_ipld_dagcbor = "=0.6.4" is declared in crates/transit/Cargo.toml but has no uses in crates/transit/src/ after the XCID handler was removed in Round 12 (XCID was the only consumer). Unused dependencies slow compile times and add supply-chain surface area.
